card.name: Final piece of brand and proper names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a name split into parts, especially the ending LA in the brand names KISUNLA and NGENLA. It also fires on the endings of names like Clairvaux, Tiananmen and Kozma.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The closing LA of the drug brand names KISUNLA and NGENLA.
modes.example: Fatal events of intracerebral hemorrhage in patients taking KISUN<<LA>> have been observed.
